Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

sRtr (development version)

  • sRtr now needs R 4.1.0 or later and dplyr 1.1.0 or later, and no longer depends on magrittr. Package code calls every function as pkg::fun() (#55).

  • The cohort-building vignette now uses the CRAN package flowchart instead of strobe, and is renamed “Building Cohorts with Flow Diagrams” (#69).

  • add_pdri() is now exported (#50).

  • add_txf_outcomes() no longer fails unless dplyr is attached (#17).

  • calculate_geography_coverage_gain() now does what its arguments say (#58):

    • method = "centroid" and method = "areal" are implemented. Before, every method gave intersection results. The default is "areal".
    • output = "wide" returns one row with <variable>_<measure> columns.
    • geography_id adds a covered_ids attribute listing the geographies counted in each area.
    • All inputs are transformed to crs first.
    • It no longer fails unless dplyr and sf are attached (#55).

  • rank_individual_coverage_gains() now defaults to method = "areal", like calculate_geography_coverage_gain() (#58).

Developed by Vagish Hemmige, Jonathan Czeresnia.
